s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute respiratory symptoms with obstructing tracheal mass
salient_findings: Polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Mass causing obstruction of main bronchi
key_facts: 48-year-old white man
Lifelong non-smoker
Remote bronchoscopic resection of tracheal carcinoid 17 years earlier
Three-month history of mild hemoptysis and cough
Non-tender subcutaneous mass on left forearm
Normal vital signs
Oxygen saturation 94% on room air
Normal complete blood count, liver and renal function tests, and coagulation profile
Chest CT scan showed polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Flexible bronchoscopy revealed mass arising from anterior tracheal wall
Mass caused 80% obstruction of right main bronchus and 70% obstruction of left main bronchus

shortlist.label: Tracheal carcinoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of tracheal carcinoid resection and current tumor morphology is consistent with carcinoid

shortlist.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Obstructing tracheal mass with subcutaneous mass, suggesting possible salivary gland-type tumor

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mild hemoptysis and cough, with a mass causing significant airway obstruction

shortlist.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute respiratory symptoms with a polypoid lesion in the trachea, consistent with salivary gland-type tumors

shortlist.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the trachea with obstructive symptoms, and a history of a previous tracheal tumor

raw.rationale: History of remote bronchoscopic resection of tracheal carcinoid and current presentation with similar symptoms and tumor characteristics

rejected.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
rejected.why: Less likely given the patient's history of tracheal carcinoid and the tumor's appearance

rejected.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
rejected.why: Not suggested by the tumor's histological description

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: Does not typically cause obstructive symptoms or have the described histological features
